question: Which of these does the harness, rather than the model, do? Select all that apply.

options.text: Runs an approved file-read and returns the result
options.feedback: Yes. The model proposes the tool call; the harness carries it out and puts the result into context.
Yes. Permissions live in the harness, outside the model.

options.text: Produces the probability distribution over next tokens
options.feedback: That is the model itself. The harness never predicts tokens.

options.text: Decides which words a token embedding sits near
options.feedback: Embeddings were learned in training. The harness has nothing to do with them.
